title: Fierce and Gentle
translation: Salutations to the fierce one, to the eternal one, to Gauri, to the supporter of all. Salutations always to her who is moonlight, who has the form of the moon, who is happiness itself.
translation_hi: रौद्रा को, नित्या को, गौरी को, धात्री को बार बार नमस्कार है। ज्योत्स्ना को, चंद्ररूपिणी को और सुखस्वरूपा को सदा नमस्कार है।

words.meaning: to her whose form is the moon
